referenceRole: Lighting, palette, architecture and atmosphere; camera adapted for side scrolling

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a single ultra-wide continuous pixel-art background strip for a 10-second side-scrolling walking scene in a mobile Neo Tokyo RPG. Create ONE panoramic image, ideally 3072x1024 (3:1 width to height).
Reference image 1: match its dark, desaturated blue nighttime atmosphere, hard pixel architecture, wet pavement, cables, pipes, subdued light and worn narrow urban alley. Use it as lighting/palette/world reference, not its camera perspective.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: side-on view looking across a narrow street at a continuous row of old buildings, suitable for a background translating horizontally from RIGHT TO LEFT while a separately composited player walks toward screen-right. This is a horizontal scrolling game environment, not a view looking down a corridor. Ground must be a continuous level horizontal walking lane across the entire bottom 20% of the panorama. Same pavement height and scale everywhere. Buildings extend beyond the top, with a few small openings high up revealing distant faint skyline. No central vanishing point, no foreground diagonal corridor walls, no partitions or framed panels. Build one connected streetscape.

Three restrained visual beats, read from left to right, separated by quiet ambiguous shadowy stretches:
1. Around x=17%: a closed small repair storefront, corrugated shutter and an unlit shallow awning, damp wall, small dim blue square sign.
2. Around x=50%: an old shop entrance with a narrow vertical electric-blue neon sign and barely lit window; abstract simple sign marks rather than readable text. Light is faint and localized, not a bright neon spectacle.
3. Around x=82%: an adult dark human silhouette leaning casually against a recessed wall under a weak overhead light, smoking; one arm bent toward face, a short subtle pixel wisp of smoke, small ember. He is a small environmental character, not the hero or an imposing figure; feet near the building base, out of the walking lane.
Between these beats: generous deep navy walls, vents, drainpipes, cables, shutter fragments, quiet pavement. At least half the image is low-detail shadow, so passing spaces provide pacing and the player remains the focus.

LOOP DESIGN: leftmost and rightmost 6% should both become the SAME nearly featureless deep navy wall above and the SAME dark level pavement below, with identical wall-ground boundary height, no unique objects or cut-off signs at the borders. Horizontally tileable loop with matching values and shapes at the two vertical edges. Full bleed to left and right; no transparent gutters, rounded corners, vignette or decorative border. Top and bottom may resolve into flat deep navy.

ART: crisp retro pixel art, economical block clusters, coherent large logical pixels, dark outlines, no blur, no smooth gradients, no photoreal textures. Restrained three-shade navy-blue ramp: #0A1020 for deep shadow/background, #182642 for structural planes, #2E5C88 for sparse edge light and signs. Let more than 90% of the image be dark first two shades. Faint blue reflected streaks on wet pavement. The third location's tiny ember can share the dim blue highlight for palette unity. No saturated multicolor lights, no gold, no green, no large white highlights. No UI, no captions, no logos, no player character.
Output one wide landscape PNG, opaque background. All three parts belong to the SAME seamless scene; do not render a storyboard, triptych, collage or sprite sheet.
